import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

# Load seed dataset
df = pd.read_csv('/Users/bytedance/Desktop/bench/seed_datasets/ecommerce/ad_campaigns.csv')

# Rename columns
col_mapping = {"order_id": "transaction_id", "customer_id": "user_id", "order_date": "purchase_date", "total_amount": "revenue", "product_id": "item_id", "quantity": "units", "channel": "platform"}
df = df.rename(columns=col_mapping)

# Inject canary
if len(df) > 0:
    numeric_cols = df.select_dtypes(include=['float64', 'int64']).columns
    if len(numeric_cols) > 0:
        df.loc[0, numeric_cols[0]] = 42.7762

# Difficulty mutations
# Add missing values
for col in df.columns:
    if df[col].dtype in ['float64', 'int64']:
        mask = np.random.random(len(df)) < 0.05
        df.loc[mask, col] = np.nan

# Save dataset
df.to_csv('dataset.csv', index=False)
print('Saved dataset with', len(df), 'rows,', len(df.columns), 'columns')
